condition: With a fill method (ffill/bfill/nearest), passing an object-dtype target that contains NaN/None to reindex or get_indexer silently matches the labels after the NaN to the wrong positions, or raises a TypeError when the target contains None.
workaround: Cast the target index to float64 (e.g. pd.Index(target, dtype=float)) before calling reindex or get_indexer with a method.
